description: Returns a map of this connector's tools, in eight groups (start, build, test_dev, site, ask_live, read_live, customers, keys_and_billing): each group's purpose in one line, then each tool with a one-line "use it when…". With goal — take payments, put my site live, sign people in, store data, run something on a schedule or event, charge credits for an action, read how the business is doing, handle a customer message, connect a domain, test before publishing — it returns only the matching group or groups and a short ordered path of tools to call; a goal it doesn't know returns the whole map and points to search_docs. Read-only: it runs no other tool, reaches nothing outside Gemmein and changes nothing; the map is bundled with the server. Works without an account.

goal.description: what your human wants done, in a few words (optional): "take payments", "put my site live"

name: tools_map
title: Map of Gemmein's tools
